lessonTitle: 15. Counting problems from games and everyday life
lessonTitleEnglish: Counting problems from games and everyday life
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 6 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: A choice tree helps count options: how many outfits from 3 shirts and 2 trousers?
stages.headlineEnglish: A choice tree helps count options: how many outfits from 3 shirts and 2 trousers?

stages.headline: Multiplication rule: m choices then n choices give m · n pairs.
stages.headlineEnglish: Multiplication rule: m choices then n choices give m · n pairs.

stages.headline: Sometimes we list all options in order: 4 friends shake hands once each. How many handshakes?
stages.headlineEnglish: Sometimes we list all options in order: 4 friends shake hands once each. How many handshakes?

stages.headline: A canteen has 4 soups and 3 salads. How many soup-and-salad meals?
